EXTRAORDINARY
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 7
Land Ministry Ref. No.: 13/2000/șʇ/242. My reference No.: WAR/LAN/ACQUS/A2/5-13.

I, hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the following land/servitude which is required for a public purpose.

Description of the Land to be acquired: Lot No. 01, 02, 03, 05, 06, 08, 09, 10, 11, 13, 14, 17, 18, 19, 20, 23, 24, 26, 29, 31, 32, 33, 34, 36, 38, 39, 40, 42, 43, 45, 47 and 49 (Lots 32) allotments in extent of about 0.1669 Hectare of land in Preiminary Plan No. Ke.3208 and dated 11.08.2006 prepared by the Senior Superintendent of Surveys of Kegalle on behalf of the Surveyor General situated in the village of Othnapitiya in the Grama Nildhari Division of 84A, Othnapitiya in the Minor Division of Keerawelipaththu North in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Warakapola in Kegalle District in Sabaragamuwa Province.
